svg.title: Hall's neighbourhood condition
svg.desc: One bipartite graph has three selected vertices and four available neighbours, allowing three disjoint matches. Another has three selected vertices but only two neighbours, so saturation is impossible.
Figure labels: Enough neighbours; A deficient set; S ⊆ X; N(S) ⊆ Y; |N(S)| = 4 ≥ 3 = |S|; S ⊆ X; N(S); |N(S)| = 2 < 3 = |S|
